script: How to catch a liar in exactly three seconds. If you feel someone is deceiving you, a partner, a friend, anyone, use these steps. Number one: The freeze response. Ask a specific question, then immediately watch their hands and feet. If they suddenly stop moving or lock their ankles, their brain may be in fight-or-flight mode. But to me, they're hiding something. Number two: The repeat trap. If they repeat your question back to you before answering, they may be stalling for time. Don't rush them. Let the silence do the work, even if it feels uncomfortable. Number three: Stay calm. Ask the same thing again in a different way. Notice the details. Stay consistent. Never accuse.
